npc_route_policy: NPCs are stationed for this proof unless grounded walk animation exists; no static sprite glide is accepted.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Make landfall at Newport Harbor; face inland from the working wharf.
playthrough_trace.note: Arrival at Newport Harbor frames the player as a newcomer stepping off the working wharf.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Follow the harborfront road to Edrin Vale at the Counting House.
playthrough_trace.note: The first objective and route hint orient the player toward Edrin at the Counting House.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Ask at the wharf apron, merchant row, or civic notice board about the missing ledger line.
playthrough_trace.note: Edrin gives the missing manifest problem a civic and personal reason to care.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Edrin Vale: The missing line is not a mistake. Ask the wharf who handled the cargo, then listen at the Tavern/Inn.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Take the west connector to Bess Armitage at the Tavern/Inn.
playthrough_trace.note: A dockworker clue makes the mystery physical instead of abstract ledger text.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Mara Pike: That crate was not lost. Someone made it disappear before the tide bell.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Choose a next lead: Edrin, the wharf lanterns, or the rear service lane.
playthrough_trace.note: The Tavern/Inn turns investigation into a pre-Revolution whisper-network fantasy.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Bess Armitage: Third Toast, then no names. If the lantern burns twice at the wharf, someone chose a side.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Return by the central connector and secure a trusted contact before dawn.
playthrough_trace.note: The wharf lantern rumor confirms that working harbor life is tied to the secret.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Jonah Reed: Two lanterns means the cargo was claimed. One means it sank. Tonight there were two.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Carry the proof into dawn before the Governor's men close the harbor.
playthrough_trace.note: The first return grants a named contact and points the player toward dawn.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Edrin Vale: Keep the missing line out of official ink until dawn. Come back when the harbor bell changes.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Take the old road marker toward the signal rise and hidden landing.
playthrough_trace.note: The village edge becomes a readable island lead rather than a dead border.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Isla Brooke: The hill lantern was not farmer's work. Follow the old road, but keep the harbor at your back.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Take the old road marker toward the signal rise and hidden landing.
playthrough_trace.note: The tavern code carries the player into island exploration.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Elias Ward: The old road remembers kings better than clerks remember cargo. Look where the road stops pretending.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Search the hidden landing for proof of the missing manifest line.
playthrough_trace.note: Optional signal lore enriches the route without blocking progress.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Mara Oren: One lantern for weather, two for warning, three for men who should not be ashore.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Choose who receives the proof: Edrin at the Counting House or Annelise on the return lane.
playthrough_trace.note: The hidden landing provides physical evidence and a Resolve reward.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Tomas Reed: If the manifest lost a line, the cove kept the ink. That rope was cut after midnight.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper
Reward: Resolve +8 for proving the island clue

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Carry the proof into dawn before the Governor's men close the harbor.
playthrough_trace.note: Annelise makes the return route socially meaningful and gives the player a choice in who carries the truth.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Annelise Crow: Bring the rope mark to Edrin. I will make sure the tavern hears the safer half of the truth.

playthrough_trace.response_text: Edrin Vale: This tar mark is not Newport work. At first light, the Governor's men will ask the wrong questions. We ask first.
